explication: ESP Website is a Django application for managing the logistics of short-term educational programs. A typical user enters through the website, finds a program, and uses program modules for activities such as registration or administration; the system’s domain models hold program, class, user, resource, and application state. Other major capabilities include automatic scheduling, accounting, surveys, configurable forms and themes, and email. The graph combines documented product purpose with indexed source references; several subsystems are represented by their core model or controller because their full implementations were not sampled.
